author: spidey simp
description: A joke cog that reacts to users claiming another member's identity and can impersonate the triggering user through a webhook. Includes server controls, cooldowns, and an opt-out system.
install_msg: Thank you for installing IdentityTheft! Use `[p]load identitytheft`, then `[p]help IdentityTheft` to get started. Webhook impersonation requires the bot to have permission to manage webhooks.
short: A playful identity theft response cog
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs for users who opt out of webhook impersonation.
